title: Coefficient representatives with a common generic differential basis
statement: Let $(B,\mathfrak n)$ be a reduced complete Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] of characteristic $p>0$, equidimensional of finite dimension $e\geq1$ (meaning $\dim(B/\mathfrak q)=e$ for every minimal prime $\mathfrak q$) [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], with residue field $k$. Optionally fix a perfect subfield $k_0\subseteq B$, meaning that $x\mapsto x^p$ is bijective on $k_0$. There exist a field section $s:k\hookrightarrow B$ of the residue map and $a_1,\ldots,a_e\in\mathfrak n$ such that, for every minimal prime $\mathfrak q$, the images of $\mathrm da_1,\ldots,\mathrm da_e$ form a basis of $\widehat\Omega_{B/k}\otimes_B\operatorname{Frac}(B/\mathfrak q)$. The $k$-algebra structure is $s$; $\widehat\Omega_{B/k}:=\varprojlim_m\Omega_{B/k}/\mathfrak n^m\Omega_{B/k}$, where $\Omega$ is the module of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. When $k_0$ was fixed, $s$ restricts to the given inclusion of $k_0$ (identified with its image in $k$).

source.place: Expose IV, 2.1.4–2.1.11 (coefficient representatives and generic rank e), 2.1.9–2.1.10 and first paragraph of 2.1.12 (common exact differential basis, moved into the maximal ideal by pth powers); compatibility with a perfect subfield follows from 2.1.4 since its elements have unique compatible p-power roots.
